# Barrowworks balance table

**Generated from the build; do not edit.** `BarrowworksBalanceTests` fights each row in the real simulation over the game's own content in 12 worlds and fails when this file differs. Regenerate after an intended tuning change with `UNNAMED_WRITE_BALANCE=1 dotnet test tests/Application.Tests --filter BarrowworksBalance` and review the diff.

The fighter is the review route's: it closes, circles toward the Custodian's slow side, dodges a late windup with stamina to spare, swings whenever free and takes a minor salve below a third of health. A level-L character has put its L-1 points into Might.
